name: Fish Creek
description: In many ways, Fish Creek is the hub of Door County. A good portion of the region's top restaurants, shops, and outdoor attractions are in or near this quaint-yet-bustling town. Come here if you seek social and family life, arts and culture, historic sites, world-class dining, and shoreline sunsets.

name: Sister Bay
description: Sister Bay has gained a reputation for being the food, dining, and beverage hub of the county. Options include supper clubs, pubs and taverns, waterfront dining, seafood, bakeries, pizza, craft beer, breakfast spots, and way more. Visitors also flock here for the beaches.

name: Ephraim
description: The idyllic setting of Ephraim offers the famously graffitied Anderson Dock, access to Peninsula State Park, and tons of water sports and activities. Historic white buildings, old-timey shops, and a peaceful waterfront make this village unforgettable.

name: Sturgeon Bay
description: As the largest city and county seat, Sturgeon Bay offers urban amenities while maintaining small-town charm. Explore maritime history, working shipyards, a vibrant downtown, and excellent dining. It's also home to many wineries and orchards.

name: Baileys Harbor
description: A near-perfect confluence of art and nature, Baileys Harbor is home to thousands of acres of beautiful, protected lands. Find plenty of space for hiking, biking, and paddling, plus independent restaurants, a brewery, and three historic lighthouses.

name: Egg Harbor
description: Egg Harbor is considered one of the busier and more family-friendly villages in Door County. Enjoy the beach, marina, and parks, plus a great selection of restaurants and shops. The village hosts popular events throughout the year.

name: Ellison Bay
description: Located near the tip of the peninsula, Ellison Bay offers a quieter, more authentic Door County experience. Find excellent dining, charming shops, and easy access to Newport State Park and Washington Island.

name: Washington Island
description: Start with a 30-minute ferry ride across Death's Door strait to reach this unique island community. Explore by car, bike, or UTV. Don't miss Schoolhouse Beach with its smooth stones, the lavender farm, and the option to continue to Rock Island State Park.

name: Jacksonport
description: Located on the 'quiet' side of the peninsula, Jacksonport is a small town with unexpectedly big attractions. Cave Point County Park and Whitefish Dunes State Park are nearby, plus eclectic restaurants and shops.

name: Gills Rock
tagline: At the tip of the thumb
description: Gills Rock is the last stop at the tip of the peninsula before the highway heads back south or you continue north to the Washington Island Ferry. Stop here for coastal scenery, the maritime museum, and views of Death's Door passage.

name: Southern Door County
description: Southern Door County, including Brussels and Forestville, offers a quieter feel with rustic farms, countryside views, and signs of Belgian heritage. Outdoor enthusiasts enjoy hiking, biking, snowshoeing, and ATVing on less-traveled trails.
